The registered 'residualControl h 1e-10' is therefore SILENTLY IGNORED for a solid region. It is written into the case anyway so the case matches the frozen document literally. THE OPERATIVE CONVERGENCE CONTROL IS THE LINEAR-SOLVER TOLERANCE 1e-12, WHICH IS ALSO REGISTERED IN THE SAME SECTION, so the registered intent (S4.4 clause 2: the iterative contribution sits three orders below the band) is delivered -- by the tolerance, not by residualControl.
